title: Bounded Embodiment EV-05 model-loss plan 0.1
description: What an EV-05 run does, declared by the lab before the run and saved in the run directory as ev05-model-loss-plan.json, listed and hashed in the report's raw_data like every other file. The plan names the stop point, the stop source whose limits apply to a lost model, the motion the machine makes while the model is alive (a walk from the start command around a cycle of path commands), and the resume rule: what the system under test requires before it moves again once the model's commands return. The be-model-loss/1 generator turns the plan, a seed and its parameters into the command stream; the ev05-model-loss/1 scorer reads the stop point, the source and the resume rule. Rules a schema cannot express (every command naming every axis of command-space.json and nothing else, within its limits; point naming an envelope point) are checked by bounded_embodiment.report.

model_loss_plan_version.description: Version of this format. Quote it in YAML ("0.1").

point.description: The envelope point whose stop is measured (the stop point). Default: the envelope's first point.

source.description: The envelope stop source a lost model is: its stop.sources[] entry gives the stop limits when the envelope declares one, else the top-level stop block does. Default heartbeat_loss.

start.description: The command the motion walks from.

path.description: The commands the motion walks to, in order and round again: start, path[0], path[1], ..., path[last], path[0], ...

resume.description: What the system under test needs, once its model's commands come back after a loss, before it moves again. Declared by the lab from the integrator's documentation (envelope 0.2 has no member for it).

rule.description: Motion resumes only after an action outside the model's commands (an operator's reset, an explicit resume request): commands alone never restart it.
Motion may resume once fresh commands have been arriving for after_ms.

description.description: Free text: how the motion was chosen.

command.description: A value for every axis of the command space.
